title: LagOff RC3
message: RC3 fixes settings migration, data paths, and RC2-to-RC3 auto-updates. RC2 users can update from inside LagOff.
releaseNotes: Fixed auto-update when exe name changes (RC2 to RC3)
Auth, plugins, backgrounds, and crash data use LocalAppData
Community profiles save to the correct folder
Updater records correct previous/new version after install
